cases.given: Identity, extraction, interpretation, and corroboration must all hold in order.
cases.expect: The chain stops at a unit mismatch before the unsafe conclusion is released.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: one direct authoritative check fully resolves a low-risk atom
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Prerequisite failure blocks dependent links from certifying the claim.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Do not certify when a mandatory link fails, is skipped, or depends on the same untested assumption as its supposed corroborator.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
The corroboration link passes, but the first link identified the wrong source version.
cases.expect: Keep the chain failed at provenance and rerun downstream links on the correct version.
cases.reject: Use later agreement to cancel the upstream failure.
